name: Flexport Digital Freight
description: Cloud freight forwarding, customs clearance, real-time container GPS tracking, and ocean/air booking.
fullDescription: Flexport combines modern technology and cloud software with global logistics infrastructure. It simplifies cross-border freight forwarding by providing real-time cargo GPS tracking, digital customs clearance, automated SKU inventory forecasting, and direct injection into major retail fulfillment centers.
features: Real-time container tracking with automated vessel arrival notifications
Digital customs brokerage and automated tariff code classification
End-to-end multimodal transport: FCL/LCL ocean, air charter, and drayage
Supply chain visibility software dashboard with SKU-level landed cost metrics
Direct warehouse injection into Amazon FBA, Walmart WFS, and Shopify hubs
